name: ViralHemorrhagicFeverTestsForViralHemorrhagicFeverVirusAntibody
title: Viral Hemorrhagic Fever (Tests for Viral Hemorrhagic Fever Virus Antibody)
description: This value set should only include hemorrhagic conditions caused by the following viruses: Filoviruses: Ebola virus and Marburg virus Old-world arenaviruses: Lassa virus and Lujo virus New- world arenaviruses: Guanarito, Machupo, Junin, and Sabia viruses Crimean Congo hemorrhagic fever viruses
purpose: (Clinical Focus: This set of values contains codes for laboratory test names associated with detecting the presence of Viral Hemorrhagic Fever antibody (IgG and IgM unspecified).),(Data Element Scope: Laboratory tests names that were ordered or observed.),(Inclusion Criteria: See note for included viruses; LOINCS specifiying 'Ab' only),(Exclusion Criteria: none)
